TD-HM-001._note: target-side reproducibility metadata captured 2026-08-31 via hdc param/hidumper; screen params are never a Gate quality condition

feature_notes.FEAT-LOCAL-ACCOUNT: Add-account screen Local (On Device) path: create local account, enter main app
feature_notes.FEAT-ADD-FEED: Add RSS/Atom subscription by URL, confirm feed added and listed
feature_notes.FEAT-FEED-REFRESH: Manual refresh pulls latest entries from network feed
feature_notes.FEAT-ARTICLE-READ: Open article reading view, render title/content, in-app reader behavior
feature_notes.FEAT-READ-UNREAD: Toggle read/unread state of an article (manual mark and open-marks-read)
feature_notes.FEAT-STAR: Add/remove star (saved) state of an article
feature_notes.FEAT-LOCAL-PERSISTENCE: Feeds, articles, read/star states and settings persist locally across app restart
feature_notes.FEAT-SETTINGS: Settings screen: view and change core local preferences (theme/sort/refresh behavior)
feature_notes.FEAT-ONLINE-ACCOUNT-UI: Add-account screen online options (Feedbin/FreshRSS/Miniflux/Reader): entry presence, login form surfaces, source-level behavior contract
feature_notes.FEAT-ONLINE-SYNC-RUNTIME: Real online-account login plus bidirectional sync executed at runtime against Feedbin/FreshRSS/Miniflux/Reader servers

feature_verify_modes._note: verify_mode consumed by Phase 2 feature-map; RUNTIME features require oracle-backed before/after evidence on ENV-001; SOURCE_CONFIRM features require source-anchored behavior contracts without runtime evidence

key_business_capabilities: Article fetch and manual refresh from network feeds
Article reading view with content rendering
Local persistence of feeds, articles, read/star states and settings
Settings management of core user preferences
Account model: local device account (runtime); online account surfaces (source-confirm)

data_scope.local_database: feeds (subscriptions), articles (entries incl. read/star flags), tags/folders
data_scope.preferences: local user preferences (theme, sort order, refresh behavior, reader options)
data_scope.network_data: public stable RSS feeds used for RUNTIME fetch tests; feed content varies over time and is environment noise: assertions must target structural facts, never specific article titles/dates
data_scope.excluded_data: online account credentials and server-side data (environment unavailable)

allowed_platform_substitutions.reason: Android navigation (back stack, Navigation Compose) replaced by ArkUI Navigation and system back
Bottom navigation bar replaced by ArkUI Tabs
Android back gesture/button replaced by HarmonyOS system back interaction
ModalBottomSheet/Drawer surfaces replaced by ArkUI Sheet
AlertDialog/Dialog surfaces replaced by ArkUI CustomDialog/AlertDialog
Switch/Toggle controls replaced by ArkUI Toggle
Selection/date/time pickers replaced by ArkUI Picker
ContextMenu/long-press menus replaced by HarmonyOS system menus
Runtime permission dialogs and flows adapted to HarmonyOS permission model

migration_policies._FUNCTIONAL_EQUIVALENCE_note: data/business computation/state transitions/persistence/side effects must not drift
migration_policies._UI_FIDELITY_note: page information architecture/content/key controls/icons/visual hierarchy/key colors must be preserved
migration_policies._NATIVE_ADAPTATION_note: only Navigation/Tabs/back/Sheet/Dialog/Toggle/Picker/system menus/permission interactions may be platform-substituted (see allowed_platform_substitutions); consumed by Phase 3/4 gates

migration_scope._visual_parity_mode_note: enum: strict | native-adaptive; new runs default to native-adaptive; runs missing this field are treated as legacy strict

test_seed.initial_state: cold-start first screen is Add Account with exactly five options: Local (On Device)/Feedbin/FreshRSS/Miniflux/Reader
test_seed.default_sort: factory default sort for fresh install (exact default value to be source-confirmed in Phase 2)
test_seed.reset_procedure: adb -s emulator-5554 shell pm clear com.capyreader.app.debug, then cold start; first screen must be Add Account (five options)
test_seed._note: Phase 2 and Phase 4 must test from this identical seed; seed facts measured on 2026-08-31 from screenshot /tmp/capy_first.png and live device

environments.seed_reset_ref: pm clear + cold start returns to Add-Account first screen (see test_seed.reset_procedure)
environments.network_conditions_ref: Wi-Fi online, public internet reachable, public stable RSS feeds fetchable
environments._screen_purpose_note: resolution and density_dpi are experiment reproducibility metadata only, never a quality or equivalence condition
